company.description: Case-insensitive substring match on company name, e.g. CHUAN LIM.
company.title: Company name contains

expiryFrom.description: Earliest registration expiry date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Expiry dates are as published in the 12 Jan 2026 source snapshot.
expiryFrom.title: Expiry from (YYYY-MM-DD)

expiryTo.description: Latest registration expiry date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.
expiryTo.title: Expiry to (YYYY-MM-DD)

grade.description: Exact grade match (case-insensitive), e.g. B2, L1, Single Grade.
grade.title: Grade equals

hasAwards.description: true = only firms with at least one GeBIZ award FY2021-FY2026; false = only firms with none; empty = all.
hasAwards.title: Has GeBIZ awards

limit.description: Maximum registration rows pushed to the dataset. Leave empty to return all matching rows.
limit.title: Max rows returned

minAwardCount.description: Minimum number of GeBIZ awards (FY2021-FY2026) the firm must have won.
minAwardCount.title: Min GeBIZ award count

minTotalAwarded.description: Minimum total GeBIZ awarded value in SGD (FY2021-FY2026).
minTotalAwarded.title: Min total awarded (SGD)

mode.description: rows = matching registration rows to the dataset; analytics = derived analytics to the key-value store (record ANALYTICS); both = both.
mode.title: Mode

postalCode.description: Postal code prefix match, e.g. 73 for the 73xxxx district.
postalCode.title: Postal code starts with

workhead.description: Exact BCA workhead code (case-insensitive), e.g. CW02, CR08, ME05. The register has 71 workheads.
workhead.title: Workhead equals
